values.name: ACCEPTED
values.doc: The order, or an amend of it, was accepted.

values.name: FILLED
values.doc: The order filled, partly or fully.

values.name: CANCELED
values.doc: The order ended without filling its remainder.

values.name: REPLACED
values.doc: A replace ended the order, or created it as the successor.

values.name: ATTACHED_RISK
values.doc:
One of the order's attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing-stop
 legs changed.
